mission_2.prediction: Out of 2 planners BFS and DFS on the constrained map I would say that BFS would finish sooner. I predict this because in mission 1 the BFS path was significantly shorter than the DFS path.
mission_2.performance: From my predicted pair BFS had a status of succeeded, elapsed_s was 89.942, and distance_m was 23.9265, DFS had a status of timeout, elapsed_s was 179.988, and distance_m was 35.3226. This result does support my prediction because the BFS was faster and actually completed its route. The planned route for DFS was a lot more complex because it had to keep going back and forth when it got to the middle section, making its path significantly longer, which increases the time it takes to complete the path. Since it had to make so make turns and traverse such a small amount of area with so many moves it hit the limit and timed out.
mission_2.choice: While BFS is the obvious choice over DFS I don't think I can say it is the better choice overall. Another good choice that I'm looking at in the map is nav2. Nav2 also has a status of succeeded and its execution time was 72.8. That is less than the BFS time and its path is also a little bit shorter. This is due to their paths being slightly different. BFS is very angular in its path while nav2 goes with the curve and takes slight shortcuts instead of hitting the sharp turns. In terms of their error, they have a very similar value but nav2 is slightly less. Due to this I would pick nav2 when compared against BFS, but BSF when compared to DFS. What matters more to me in my choice is that the route is completed in a timely and effective manner with no added or extra unnecessary steps.
